ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Act 2015 (AML/CFT Act), as amended, and Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Regulations 2016; beneficial ownership definitions and CDD obligations under Part 4 (Sections 13–23). The Registrar of Corporations maintains a confidential beneficial ownership register pursuant to Registry Directive No. 1 of 2018, issued under the Business Corporations Act (B.C.A.), 1990, as amended, and FIU directives on beneficial ownership reporting.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening against the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, the RMI Attorney-General's Sanctions Notice (issued under the United Nations Sanctions Act), and, for USD-clearing or US-correspondent banking transactions, the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) List. Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) are defined under the AML/CFT Act and require enhanced due diligence, including senior management approval, source-of-wealth verification, and ongoing transaction monitoring. RMI FIU directives make these protocols binding on reporting entities.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Marshall Islands Corporate Registry (administered via International Registries, Inc.) – https://www.register-iri.com/
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be expressed in the English language using Latin alphabet characters. Foreign-language names require a certified transliteration into Roman letters. Diacritical marks not supported by the RMI registry system render a name unavailable. The name must be distinguishable from all existing registered names and have no deceptively similar phonetic or visual similarity.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection of a name reservation, the applicant may file a written appeal with the Registrar of Corporations within 14 days of the rejection notice. The appeal must include a legal memorandum addressing the Registrar's stated ground of refusal and any alternative names. If the Registrar upholds the rejection, a second administrative appeal may be submitted to the Minister of Justice within 30 days. The Minister's decision is delivered within 30 days of filing. Simultaneously, the applicant may submit a new name reservation with a revised name to avoid delays.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: For a non-resident Business Corporation engaged solely in delivery-only multi-brand cloud kitchen operations, a virtual office is permissible for correspondence and communication, provided that a physical registered office in the Marshall Islands is continuously maintained through a licensed registered agent. The RMI registered office is a statutory, not operational, address; the actual kitchen facility must comply with the local operating jurisdiction's licensing and health-safety requirements.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low – estimated annual probability of an unannounced inspection at the RMI registered office is below 10% for a low-risk, non-resident, delivery-only entity. By contrast, the operational ghost kitchen facility in the local market is subject to mandatory health and food-safety inspections, typically 1–2 scheduled inspections per year, with additional spot checks possible.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act 1990 (as amended), Marshall Islands Revised Code (MIRC) Title 34, Chapter 1; in particular § 204 (Articles of Incorporation), § 205 (Certificate of Incorporation), § 226 (Registered Office and Registered Agent), and § 227 (By-Laws); read together with the Income Tax Act 1989 (MIRC Title 13) for the Non-Resident Domestic Corporation tax-exempt regime.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: The Registrar of Corporations, Commercial Registry, Republic of the Marshall Islands (Majuro), acting through licensed Marshall Islands resident registered agents.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (BC Form 1) executed by the incorporator and lodged with the Registrar of Corporations; issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation constitutes completion of incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital: the Articles of Incorporation need only state the authorized share capital (e.g., US$1.00 or one no-par share). No escrow or trust account is mandated by the Business Corporations Act; the Registrar's US$275 incorporation fee and US$100 prepaid first-year franchise tax are remitted through the licensed registered agent's client account.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
RESOLVED, that the corporation hereby subscribes to, accepts, and records in the share register the issuance of [•] common shares authorized by the Articles of Incorporation, upon receipt of the stated subscription consideration.

RESOLVED, that the registered office be and hereby is established at [address], Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands, maintained with [Registered Agent], the corporation's licensed resident registered agent.

RESOLVED, that [Name] be appointed Chief Executive Officer, [Name] Chief Financial Officer, and [Name] Corporate Secretary, each to hold office until resignation, removal, or successor appointment.

RESOLVED, that the officers are authorized to execute all statutory filings, elect tax-exempt non-resident status, open delivery-platform merchant accounts, and adopt the corporate seal on behalf of the corporation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations via licensed registered agent (RMI Commercial Registry e-portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge an online Name Reservation Request for three ranked proposed names ending in 'Corporation', 'Inc.', 'Limited', or 'Ltd.' The registered agent conducts a name search against the Corporate Name Index and confirms no conflict with protected statutory names. Approved names receive a priority reservation for 60 days.
required_dossiers: Draft Articles of Incorporation (name and purpose only)
Consent to Act as Registered Agent
AML/KYC intake form with beneficial ownership details
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested name is refused as confusingly similar or non-reservable, the agent immediately files the second-ranked name; a protest may be submitted to the Registrar within 14 days, and a refusal is appealable to the RMI High Court within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Incorporator and licensed registered agent; execution witnessed per MIRC § 204
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent drafts the Articles of Incorporation (corporate name, registered office, registered agent, authorized shares, and permitted purpose covering delivery-only multi-brand cloud kitchen operations) and the By-Laws. The incorporator executes the Articles; each director signs a consent to act; each officer signs an acceptance of office.
required_dossiers: Consent to Act as Director of each director
Acceptance of Office by each officer
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Drafting defects are corrected by re-executing the document before filing; if already lodged, a corrective amendment under MIRC § 226 (Articles of Amendment) is filed to cure omissions or inconsistencies.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Lodgment of Articles and Payment of Government Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Commercial Registry, Majuro (filing through the licensed registered agent's trust account)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent lodges the executed Articles of Incorporation with the Registrar, together with the US$275 statutory filing fee for authorized capital up to 10,000 shares and prepayment of the US$100 first-year franchise tax. Submission is made via the e-portal with scanned PDFs; original executed documents remain with the agent.
required_dossiers: Filing fee remittance instruction to agent trust account
Registered Agent consent and registered office declaration
AML/KYC file (beneficial owner passport, proof of address, bank reference letter)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a deficiency query, the registered agent resubmits corrected Articles within 30 days with a US$50 re-filing fee; an erroneously accepted filing may be withdrawn and replaced, and a final refusal is appealable to the High Court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Registered Agent Acceptance
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon acceptance, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the corporate seal, incorporation date, and registration number. Certified copies and a Certificate of Good Standing are obtained for banking and merchant-account purposes; the registered agent records the registered office acceptance.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation (original and certified copies)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains typographical or legal defects, apply to the Registrar for a re-issued certificate at no additional incorporation fee; any discrepancy in the register is corrected through a status certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Organizational Resolutions: First Board of Directors Meeting
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors and Corporate Secretary; minutes recorded in the corporate records book
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting or adopt a unanimous written consent to ratify the By-Laws, fix the fiscal year, approve share issuance and allotment, confirm the registered office and agent appointments, authorize opening of bank accounts and delivery-platform merchant accounts (UberEats and DoorDash payouts), and adopt the pro-forma resolutions.
required_dossiers: First Board Meeting Minutes or Unanimous Written Consent
Bank account opening pack with certified constitutional documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If minutes are incomplete or contain errors, a corrective unanimous written consent of the board is adopted at the next meeting; statutory registers may not be backdated, so corrections are annotated and initialed by the Corporate Secretary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Compliance, KYC and Tax Registrations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered agent, RMI Treasury, and the Business License Office / Majuro Atoll Local Government
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the annual compliance package: pay the annual franchise tax (US$100), file the beneficial ownership declaration with the registered agent, apostille the Certificate of Incorporation, register as employer if hiring staff, and obtain the Non-Resident Corporation tax-exemption declaration confirming no RMI-source income is derived.
required_dossiers: Tax exemption application under the Income Tax Act 1989
KYC file (passport, utility bill, ownership structure chart)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the annual franchise tax is overdue, a 10% monthly penalty is applied; submit a late-filing correction letter with the outstanding fee and penalty, after which the Registrar re-issues a Certificate of Good Standing.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Business License Office, Office of the Attorney General, Republic of the Marshall Islands; coordinated with the Majuro Atoll Local Government (MALGov) trade-license division and the Ministry of Health and Human Services (Environmental Health Section).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Commercial Business Activity License (Food Services and Delivery-Only Cloud Kitchen) under the Business License Act 1991, together with a Food Service Establishment Permit covering off-premises, multi-brand virtual-brand kitchen operations issued by the Ministry of Health and Human Services.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Authority of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI EPA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Tier 2 — Registration with Preliminary Environmental Report (PER) required; a full Environmental Impact Assessment is not triggered for an enclosed delivery-only kitchen with packaged orders and no sit-down dining.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with RMI Environmental Quality Protection Regulations 1989: wastewater pH 6.0–9.0; oil and grease ≤ 10 mg/L; BOD5 ≤ 30 mg/L; TSS ≤ 50 mg/L before municipal sewer discharge; adequately sized and serviced grease traps; kitchen exhaust passing through grease filters and carbon odor control; no untreated process wastewater discharged to Majuro Lagoon; solid waste disposed at MALGov-approved landfill; noise limits observed for hood ventilation fans and delivery staging areas.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Clearance Certificate from the RMI Fire Marshal's Office (fire extinguisher zoning, commercial kitchen hood suppression system, and egress plan); structural load inspection and occupancy certificate from the Ministry of Public Works; workplace food-safety clearance and food-handler certifications from the Ministry of Health and Human Services (Environmental Health), including occupational hygiene clearance for heat, grease, ventilation, and segregated raw/ready-to-eat food zones.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Revenue and Taxation Division, Ministry of Finance of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities are not required to obtain a Marshall Islands Tax Identification Number (TIN) unless deriving Marshall Islands-source business income subject to Gross Revenue Tax; Business Corporations without RMI-source income are tax-exempt and no registration is required. For entities requiring a GRT account, file a registration application with the Revenue and Taxation Division, providing a certified copy of the certificate of incorporation and applicable business license.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None available; RMI does not offer check-the-box or hybrid mismatch elections. A Business Corporation may elect or maintain status as a non-resident entity under the Business Corporations Act, thereby remaining exempt from RMI gross revenue tax on foreign-source income.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None (no VAT/GST/sales and use tax imposed at national level; customs import duty applies separately)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable; no indirect tax registration regime exists
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No electronic invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, API, or digital stamping mandate in the RMI.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable because RMI does not impose VAT/GST. Exports of goods or offshore services are not subject to an indirect tax, and therefore no zero-rating claim or refund mechanism exists under domestic law.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No indirect tax clawback applies in the absence of VAT/GST; general customs penalties, including fines and seizure, may be imposed for false export declarations under RMI Customs Regulations.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: No central bank exists in the Republic of the Marshall Islands; banking supervision and non-bank deposit licensing are administered by the Banking Commissioner, Ministry of Finance, with the US dollar as sole legal tender under the Compact of Free Association.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Marshall Islands has no domestic currency; the US dollar is the sole legal tender. Both current-account and capital-account transactions are fully convertible and free from exchange controls, with no restrictions on profit, dividend, or distribution remittances to non-resident shareholders. A Non-Resident Business Corporation claiming statutory tax exemption under the Business Corporations Act must nonetheless show that no local business is conducted in the Marshall Islands, and in practice its treasury operations clear through offshore USD correspondent accounts because on-island branches require local substance for sustained mid-market banking activity.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Not applicable. Marshall Islands law imposes no export-proceeds surrender obligation, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no repatriation timeline for export or service receipts. Revenues of the ghost kitchen entity are held and settled directly in US dollars without central bank intervention; no exchange control approval is required to retain funds abroad.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Operational Account (USD current and settlement)
Capital Escrow Account / Operational Account / Trade Account (USD correspondent-cleared)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility: Medium with material caveats. Regulated offshore digital EMIs and licensed payment institutions can accept a Marshall Islands Non-Resident Business Corporation only after enhanced due diligence, and several Tier-1 platforms (Wise, Airwallex, Payoneer) classify RMI tax-exempt structures as higher-risk due to the absence of central bank supervision. Onboarding is contingent on delivery-platform agreements proving ISIC 5610 operational substance, but EMIs remain unsuitable as the sole treasury rail because they cannot issue commercial letters of credit, hold escrowed capital, or provide committed credit facilities.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical appearance of all directors and authorised signatories at a licensed branch in Majuro or Ebeye is the default mandate; no statutory remote-onboarding right exists. Remote opening is possible only for existing or referred banking relationships using registry-certified corporate documents, notarised passport copies, and a board resolution executed under the registered agent's attestation, with a mandatory video conference interview acceptable in limited circumstances at the bank's discretion.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Registered-agent nominee arrangement obscures the identity of the true beneficial owner of the Non-Resident Business Corporation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current Certificate of Good Standing from the RMI Corporate Registry; registered-agent nominee disclosure; certified UBO declaration identifying each natural person owning 10% or more and all controlling officers; organizational chart linking nominees to principals; passport and proof-of-address for each UBO; signed W-8BEN-E or Form 6166 tax-residency certificate proving the structure is not an OFAC-listed shell.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Statutory tax-exemption and non-resident status are interpreted by the bank as absence of economic substance or tax-haven indicia.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board-approved business plan for delivery-only multi-brand operations; executed virtual-brand license agreements; delivery aggregator marketplace agreements (UberEats, DoorDash); kitchen facility lease or ghost-kitchen management agreement in the operating jurisdiction; payroll and supplier contracts; intercompany settlement calendar proving the BC performs contracting, brand, and treasury functions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound wires originate from food-delivery marketplace payout files that lack per-transaction sales reconciliation, triggering source-of-funds queries.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Aggregator payout summary reports with merchant ID mapping; daily order and settlement ledgers; gateway service agreements; food-safety and health-inspection licenses of each ghost-kitchen site; VAT/GST filing receipts; and a six-month revenue waterfall showing platform collections net of fees into the operating entity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions screening fails because ownership chain touches contested or partially restricted jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full beneficial-ownership schedule covering all jurisdictions in the investor chain; sanctions self-certification for each UBO and entity; OFAC/SDN, EU, and UN screening results with no adverse hits; professional introducer letter from the RMI registered agent; 24-month source-of-wealth statements for all material UBOs.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Delivery-platform omnibus payouts are paid to a Non-Resident BC that maintains no physical kitchen in the Marshall Islands, raising structured-payment and licensing concerns.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Contractual matrix demonstrating the BC is the revenue-contracting and IP-licensing entity while the on-ground operating subsidiary holds the dining/delivery license; consolidated intercompany settlement agreement; regulator acknowledgment or no-action confirmation; and daily cash-flow forecast showing sweep of platform receivables to segregated disbursement accounts.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital contributions are executed in US dollars by SWIFT MT103 from the overseas shareholder's bank to the BC's USD clearing account at a licensed commercial bank or US correspondent. The wire must reference Shareholder Capital Contribution and use purpose code EQUI (equity injection) or BCT for business commercial transfer, accompanied by the signed subscription agreement, board resolution allotting shares, and share-certificate ledger. Because the Marshall Islands operates a dollarized economy with no exchange controls, no central-bank approval, FX license, or capital-import permit is required; the receiving bank will verify the non-resident status of the BC and may require the tax-exemption certificate to avoid withholding documentation.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements run through SWIFT MT103 for supplier payments, aggregator payouts, and intercompany disbursements, with MT202 for bank-to-bank nostro transfers when needed. Major capital purchases of commercial kitchen equipment and fit-out works are settled by irrevocable commercial letter of credit (MT700) issued through Bank of Guam or a US correspondent, with documents comprising commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading or air waybill, and inspection certificate. Separate segregated disbursement accounts are maintained for delivery-platform collections; daily sweeps to a master treasury account preserve reconciliation lineage for AML review and settlement of franchise/royalty fees.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Offshore deliverable US dollar FX forwards against convertible operating currencies (e.g., USD/AUD, USD/EUR, USD/CAD) executed with Tier-1 international banks
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on operating-country restricted currencies (e.g., USD/IDR, USD/PHP, USD/THB) referenced to the ghost-kitchen subsidiaries' revenue markets
Cross-currency swaps and FX swaps between USD and the operating subsidiaries' functional currencies for intercompany loan and dividend remittance hedging
Plain-vanilla currency options (EUR/USD, GBP/USD, AUD/USD) for targeted purchase-price risk on imported kitchen equipment

In no case is a Marshall Islands regulated FX product required, as the absence of a central bank and the absence of exchange controls permit unrestricted use of offshore derivatives under a board-approved treasury policy

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report (Form AR) - current directors, officers, shareholders, authorized capital, registered office, and principal business address; accompanied by payment of the annual government fee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General, Republic of the Marshall Islands (Business Corporations Act 1990, as amended)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Incorporated Jan 1 - Jun 30: due Sep 30 of the same calendar year; incorporated Jul 1 - Dec 31: due Mar 31 of the following calendar year; report cycle repeats annually on the same fixed date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: US$100 late penalty per report after the statutory due date; continued non-filing and non-payment trigger administrative dissolution (strike-off) by the Registrar; reinstatement requires payment of all arrears, penalties, and reinstatement fees

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Certificate of Good Standing (customary annual refresh for banking, payment-rail (UberEats/DoorDash), and delivery-platform due-diligence; non-mandatory but commercially expected)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General, Republic of the Marshall Islands
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Issued on application at any time; recommended annually before the incorporation anniversary and before pay-out vendor compliance reviews
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No statutory penalty for non-obtainment; absence of a current certificate may trigger account restrictions, payment holds, or deactivation by financial institutions and delivery-platform counterparties

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered office and licensed registered agent renewal (annual retainer agreement)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Marshall Islands registered agent maintaining the registered office within the Republic
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Continuous obligation; renewal must be completed on or before the Annual Report deadline (Sep 30 or Mar 31) each year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-payment or agent resignation causes loss of registered office and registered agent; the Registrar may administratively dissolve the corporation for failure to maintain the statutory agent requirement

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confidential UBO/AML confirmation to the registered agent (beneficial-ownership refresh; no public UBO registry filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed registered agent acting as anti-money-laundering obliged entity under Marshall Islands AML/CFT regulations
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on or before each incorporation anniversary and aligned with each Annual Report cycle; updated within 30 days of any share transfer or beneficial-ownership change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to provide current beneficial-ownership data impairs the agent's statutory AML obligations, may compel agent resignation, and may be reported to the financial intelligence unit / Registrar, ultimately supporting administrative strike-off

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory audit applies to a non-resident Marshall Islands Business Corporation; audit is mandated only for licensed or regulated activities (banking, insurance, trust business) or if the articles of incorporation or shareholder agreements expressly require audited financial statements
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Business Corporations Act 1990 (as amended) requires each corporation to keep correct and complete books and records of account; IFRS or US GAAP are commonly adopted and accepted; no statutory financial statements are filed with the Registrar

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The Marshall Islands maintains no public UBO register; the licensed registered agent must collect and hold confidential beneficial-ownership data under MI AML/CFT rules. Annually, the company must re-confirm directors, officers, shareholders, and ultimate beneficial owners, attaching share-transfer schedules and source-of-funds notes, so the agent can satisfy its regulatory obligations.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Books of account and accounting records

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$400 - US$1,000 per annum (licensed registered agent and registered office, all-inclusive)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not statutorily required; voluntary audit US$2,500 - US$8,000 per engagement

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% - the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) imposes no national corporate income tax; a Non-Resident Business Corporation is a zero-tax vehicle for foreign-source revenue.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Effective tax rate 0%. No corporate income tax, branch profits tax, capital gains tax, VAT/GST, payroll tax, estate tax, or gift tax applies. The annual RMI fiscal burden consists solely of the BCA annual report/franchise tax and the licensed registered agent fee. RMI social security contributions arise only if RMI-resident employees are engaged, which does not occur in this delivery-only virtual-brand structure. RMI-source business activity (e.g., food deliveries to customers located in the RMI) would trigger a business license and gross-revenue fee under the Business Licenses Act.
